items.question: Where is the DevFest Montreal 2026 event located?
items.answer: DevFest Montreal 2026 takes place at Ax.c Hub, located at 800 Square-Victoria in downtown Montreal.

items.question: When is the DevFest Montreal 2026 event taking place?
items.answer: The conference will be held on Friday, November 6, 2026, all day. Exact hours will be confirmed soon.

How do I get to DevFest - (Parking)
Parking
items.answer: Paid parking on site and around the venue

items.question: Bixi
items.answer: Drop-off station at corner of Viger/Square-Victoria

items.question: Food
items.answer: Food will be provided (morning, noon, end of day), including vegan options.

items.question: In which language will the sessions be presented?
items.answer: Sessions will be presented in English or French. The presentation language will be clearly displayed for each talk on our schedule.
